There are no clear stacks of processed lumber or modern industrial warehouse features.

The wooden beams supporting the roof have inconsistent thickness and seem to merge into the background foliage unnaturally.
The metal rails of the conveyor warp slightly and do not maintain consistent parallel perspective towards the background.

To check for anatomical correctness of the multiple human figures present.
